svg.aria-label: A twelve second timeline with four beats: the lead lands at 0.4 seconds, the auto-reply goes out at 8, the homeowner answers at 10, and the owner is notified at 12.
svg.title: Twelve seconds, to the real clock
svg.desc: The demo runs on a wall clock rather than a compressed animation. Four beats are scripted in app.js: receivedDone at 400ms, replyDone at 8000ms, answer at 10000ms and notifyDone at 12000ms. Three of them are the steps the page labels 0s, 8s and 12s. The fourth, the homeowner answering at 10 seconds, is not one of the page steps.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Twelve seconds, timed against a real clock rather than an animation.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The four beats below are the CLOCK values in app.js. The page labels three of them. The one it does not label is the reason the other three are worth anything.

svg.text: The wait is the argument. A demo that collapsed twelve seconds into two would be making the opposite case to the one on the page.

svg.text: The two lead paths, a web form and a missed call, run the same four beats. What changes is the wording, because a missed call arrives with no name attached.

svg.text: Nothing is sent. There is no network call in app.js, no key, no backend, and no third party script on the page.
